description: Tests the coordinator/gate's own identity correlation given an already-normalized event sequence where identity fields (toolCallId, toolIndex, name) are carried once on tool_call_start and never repeated on continuation deltas - only callRef.sourceKey is. This does NOT test whether any provider adapter correctly derives a stable sourceKey from a raw, id-less wire-format continuation fragment (e.g. OpenAI's index-only delta shape) - that derivation is a provider-adapter concern outside the normalized-gate profile, covered instead by this package's own internal corpus/provider-envelopes/ fixtures. Here, sourceKey continuity is simply given; the fixture only proves the gate correlates by it correctly once given.

provenance.note: Motivated by, but not a reproduction of, a real upstream bug class (continuedev/continue) where an id-less raw continuation fragment was mis-correlated at the adapter/accumulation layer. This fixture tests the analogous invariant one layer up, at the normalized-gate boundary this package owns.
